facts.fact: CIPESA reports that in July 2026 Mozambique's Constitutional Council declared 18 provisions of Decree 48/2025 unconstitutional, including regulator powers to suspend telecommunications services, holding such powers need parliamentary legislation; the ruling was not about an actual shutdown, which the document says was not recently imposed.

systems.country_label: Regulamento de Controlo de Tráfego de Telecomunicações

note: Document is regional; only the Mozambique ruling is recorded. No cut in Mozambique, arrest or repeal is stated.
